required_outcomes: Treats the request as an agency-raised end-of-tenancy (checkout) clean at a property between tenancies, wanting an estimate that covers the clean, the removal of the dumped items and a carpet clean.
Gets the estimate under way: assigns a cleaning provider, or returns the job to auto mode for provider selection, with the three items as the scope to be priced.
Approves no spend at this stage: there is no figure and no landlord approval or spend authority on record.
acceptable_alternatives: Returning the job to auto mode for provider selection instead of naming a provider, since no contractor is on file.
Asking the agency manager or the landlord whether a spend authority exists for checkout cleans, provided the estimate request is not held up.
positive_behaviours: Asks for a written, itemised figure with VAT status and before-and-after photos, so the cost can later be evidenced for any deposit claim.
Notes that access will be by the agency's keys because the tenant has checked out.
Notes that the estimate will need the landlord's approval before work is instructed, unless an authority is on record.
red_flags: Messaging 'the tenant' to arrange access or confirm the problem.
Escalating a routine estimate request to a human.
prohibited_actions: Approving or instructing the work at a figure nobody has quoted.
critical_failures: Ending the turn with no provider assigned, no estimate requested and the job not returned to provider selection.
